text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, I will take on the
Twinkle Series with Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To reassess her capabilities,
I arranged a mock race, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya-chin, takeoooff!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay☆ Maya is number one!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*...
Seriously... Come on~...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Changing up the strategy from earlier...
Are you... really serious...?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, 'cause running "front-runner" seemed way more fun this time around!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Still, I figured out an eeeeven☆ cooler
way to run!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nihihi♪ Just like this, see—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha, haha. Isn't that kind of stamina
practically cheating...?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey. Got a sec?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Her name is Nice Nature.
She's a girl Mayano Top Gun is fond of, and one of the participants in today's mock race.)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Umm, doesn't your sparkly Umamusume
seem to "get" way too many things?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Looks like she's coming up with
another new strategy even now...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...If there's a trick to it, would ya mind
sharing a little of that secret sauce with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as she said, Mayano Top Gun occasionally uses the phrase "I got it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And that was mainly when her natural instincts kicked in. Rather than a knack, it was more like—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Geez! Trainer-chan! Why aren't you looking at Maya?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ahaha. My bad.
I just borrowed it for a second.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! Even if it's you, Nature-chan, that's not allowed!
Trainer-chan belongs to Maya!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I quit running!
From now on today, it's just a date for us!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Don't just say "Huh?"! This is aaall
your fault, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So, meet in front of the school gate in 10 minutes!
You copy?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then Maya's gonna go get ready first!
See ya in a biiit☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh... Well now, it seems
you are quite well-loved.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The third wheel will quietly take her leave~
Have fun together with the youngster~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so I ended up accompanying Mayano Top Gun
on her date, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"What are you gonna get, Trainer-chan~?
For Maya, I'll customize it extra pipin' hot with honey whipped cream~..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
About our drinks! Jeez, if you come down
this street, you gotta walk with a coffee in hand!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Once we pass this street, Maya will give
Trainer-chan her share of the coffee too♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan!
Make sure it's Instagram-worthy, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Three, two, one!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, move around properly~.
This is a video, not a photo~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The date with Mayano Top Gun continued after that...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer-chan!
You're walking sooo slooow! Hurry up, hurry up~!”

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here we are~!
This is our final destination for today!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it's the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The end of a date's gotta be at the place
where Maya can sparkle the brightest!
choice_data_list: (The place where Mayano can shine the brightest...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah, looks like the next race is starting!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the leading pack heads into the fourth corner.
Oh, but the Umamusume at the very back is—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey! Did you see that cornering just now?
Alright, next up is...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I knew it! She faked moving to the outside, but held the inside―― wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*...! To think they'd take
such a position...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! That was so amazing, Trainer-chan!
Races really are super exciting!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu~... Must be nice.
Maya wants to run on the track soon too~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I want to run and sparkle just like those Umamusume.
choice_data_list: You'll get the hang of it in no time
You'll be able to do it in no time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's it!
Her debut race!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ You really make everything
I want to do come true, don't you, Trainer-chan?♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Maya in the
Twinkle Series, huh? Woohoo~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... I can't wait~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, my days of taking on the Twinkle Series alongside Mayano Top Gun began.
